resultPolicy.notApplicable: Excluded while current scope is unchanged; owner-approved scope change must revise manifest/gates first.
resultPolicy.pass: All steps and expected results actually executed; same candidate build/profile; non-empty actual + existing hashed evidence; AT/UAT/review sign-offs explicitly reviewed.
resultPolicy.fail: Actual differs; record defect ID/severity/owner; retest original case and affected regression.
resultPolicy.blocked: Record prerequisite/environment/reason/owner; does not close release gates.
resultPolicy.notRun: No execution result; empty records resolve to NOT_RUN; mapping/checklist/code inspection is never PASS.

profiles.purpose: Pure unit/contract/review; cannot close HTTP/DB/UI acceptance
Temporary local integration/UI; cannot close SQL Server or Windows sign-off

fixturePolicy.source: TeamFlow_Test_Cases_v1.0.md#ข้อมูลตั้งต้นและวิธี-reset
fixturePolicy.reset: Fresh isolated database/uploads/session jars per case; versioned synthetic seed; reset before each variant/order; never depend on another test result.
fixturePolicy.clocks: Controlled UTC/Bangkok clock only in internal test harness; never expose public fault/clock routes.
fixturePolicy.barriers: Independent DB connections + explicit barriers, timeout and finally rollback/release; run both serialization orders; no sleep-based race assertions.
fixturePolicy.credentials: Generated at execution; never store credentials/cookie/token/raw request bodies in deliverables or evidence.
fixturePolicy.uploads: Synthetic valid file bytes and hashes; 1 byte/10MiB/+1byte/empty; 5GiB quota arithmetic with stored+reserved; no live uploads/malware.

variants.title: Archived project lifecycle permissions
variants.setup: Archived project; deleted and active tasks; separate Admin, owner Lead, Editor creator and Viewer sessions.
steps: Try normal task/subtask/comment/upload/status writes as every role.
Try task delete/restore with current version as every role; reload restored task and attempt normal writes.
expected: Only Admin/owner Lead can delete/restore tasks in an archived project within retention; Editor creator is denied.
Restored task stays read-only; denied calls change no rows/events/bytes.

variants.title: Demote Admin and recompute effective rights
variants.setup: Two active Admins; target assigned open and done tasks across Admin-only, owner-Lead and explicit-Editor projects.
steps: Demote target, then reuse each old session and inspect assignments.
Repeat with a last-Admin attempt and with concurrent demote/deactivate requests.
expected: Sessions revoked; open tasks unassigned only where effective write is lost; surviving Lead/Editor assignments and done history remain.
At least one active Admin remains; cleanup and audit are atomic.

variants.title: Reopen/restore assignment eligibility
variants.setup: Done and deleted non-done tasks; assignee separately inactive, Viewer, revoked, eligible Editor or owner Lead.
steps: Reopen/restore each fixture; inspect task, event and notification rows.
Restore a deleted done task separately.
expected: Non-done tasks recheck write eligibility; ineligible assignee becomes null with audit; eligible assignee stays.
Done history is preserved; no partial transition.

variants.title: Archived team parent invariant
variants.setup: Archived team/project plus active team/project; two independent connections and deterministic barriers.
steps: Unarchive project while team archived; then unarchive team before project.
Race team archive against project create and unarchive, in both lock orders.
expected: Archived team cannot gain an active project.
Rejected transaction creates no partial project/membership/events.

variants.title: Exact UTC retention and restore versus purge
variants.setup: Task/file deleted_at fixed in controlled UTC clock; cutoff = deleted_at + 30*24h; include a daylight-saving calendar date.
steps: Restore at cutoff-1ms, cutoff and cutoff+1ms on independent reset fixtures.
Purge at all three times; race restore versus purge with barriers in both orders.
expected: Restore succeeds only strictly before cutoff; purge eligible at/after cutoff.
No half-restored relation/bytes; restored order appends; tombstones survive.

variants.title: Durable cleanup and quota accounting
variants.setup: Expired deleted attachment/task with stored bytes; inject unlink denial or missing bytes in isolated storage.
steps: Run scheduled purge and the same CLI mechanism; fail unlink, restart, release failure and retry.
Inspect cleanup tracking, quota and recurrence tombstones after every stage.
expected: Failed byte deletion retains durable tracking/accounting; successful retry finishes once.
No referenced live file is deleted; scheduler/CLI share locking and audit.

variants.title: Monthly anchor edits and successor stability
variants.setup: Jan31 monthly task with generated successor; leap/non-leap February; daily/weekly/none fixtures.
steps: Generate normally through February/March.
Edit monthly due date; enter monthly from none/weekly; leave monthly; inspect an already generated successor.
expected: Normal generation preserves anchor; editing due/entering monthly resets it; leaving clears it.
Existing successor remains unchanged; new checklist items are not done; exactly one successor.

variants.title: Revoke versus authorized write and visibility
variants.setup: Independent revoker/writer connections; pause writer after reading access but before mutation commit.
steps: Commit revocation first, release writer, then repeat with writer winning first.
After revocation request detail/download/search/notification/CSV and replay an old idempotency key.
expected: Only a serialization consistent with effective permission at the protected mutation is allowed; no write based on stale authorization after revocation wins.
New requests and replay never disclose revoked data; no partial cleanup.

variants.title: Checklist versus completion
variants.setup: Recurring task with one checklist item; separate check/uncheck and completion requests with known versions.
steps: Use barriers to complete versus uncheck/add/delete in both commit orders.
Inject failure between status, successor, audit and notification writes.
expected: Task never commits done with an incomplete checklist; stale version gives 409 or valid business rejection.
Failure rolls back all status/version/successor/audit/notification changes.

variants.title: Board rank and key races
variants.setup: Same-column and cross-column boards; distinct sessions, shared versions, deterministic commit barriers.
steps: Race moves/reorders with stale task/column versions; repeat same key then changed payload.
Abort at temporary-rank and final-rank phases and retry by key.
expected: No duplicate ranks or missing tasks; atomic rollback; versions and affected columns consistent.
Replay returns original authorized result; changed body conflicts; no double move.

variants.title: Quota finalize versus backup freeze
variants.setup: Quota near limit; two uploads, durable reservations, active streams, backup request and clock barriers.
steps: Race reservation/finalization with freeze acquisition; test both orders and crash after filesystem rename.
Backup waits for accepted requests; restart recovery then actual restore.
expected: Stored plus reserved bytes never exceed quota; freeze rejects new writes and waits for accepted work/jobs.
Snapshot contains matching DB/files; reservations/cleanup converge once after crash.

variants.title: SQL Server lock timeout
variants.setup: Isolated SQL Server2022; connection A holds a row/range lock; connection B uses bounded lock timeout.
steps: Block a real write, exhaust bounded retry budget, release lock and retry same key.
expected: 503 with Retry-After when exhausted; no partial state; retry succeeds once; readiness safe.

variants.title: SQL Server deadlock victim
variants.setup: Two independent SQL Server2022 transactions update resources in deliberately reversed order; barrier after first lock.
steps: Force a deadlock victim, observe bounded retry; force repeated victims to exhaust retry.
expected: Victim fully rolled back; successful retry creates one outcome; exhausted retries503 without partial state.

variants.title: SQL connection loss before commit
variants.setup: Isolated SQL2022 test connection; kill/disconnect after writes but before commit acknowledgement.
steps: Break connection before commit; recover with a new connection; inspect authoritative state before key retry.
expected: Uncommitted transaction rolls back; no orphan reservation/bytes; same-key retry never duplicates.

variants.title: Query timeout and unknown commit acknowledgement
variants.setup: Isolated SQL2022 proxy/harness can delay response before commit or drop acknowledgement after successful commit.
steps: Run both definitely-uncommitted timeout and committed-but-response-lost branches.
Reconnect, resolve key/state, retry same request; try same key/different body and revoked access replay.
expected: Do not assume timeout means rollback; authoritative key/state determines result.
Exactly one task/successor/move/event; permission rechecked; conflicting reuse409.

variants.title: Expiry/logout across tabs and cache
variants.setup: Two browser tabs, isolated profile, controlled session clock, same-origin proxy/cache and dirty task draft.
steps: Logout/expire/reset session in tab A then poll/write/back/forward/reload in tab B; use old CSRF.
Inspect HTTP headers, browser/proxy/SW cache and history; reconnect while draft is dirty.
expected: Sensitive data/cookies cease being usable on session/access loss; API/files are not cached.
Polling does not extend idle expiry; normal refresh preserves authorized draft; no queued offline writes.

variants.title: Visible refresh timing and scoped revisions
variants.setup: Two visible online sessions; fake Bangkok midnight for date cases; unrelated private project for revision privacy.
steps: Measure from committed mutation to visible UI across poll schedule and response latency.
Cross Bangkok midnight with unchanged revision; mutate hidden project; revoke access while form dirty.
expected: Visible updates within10s; overdue/date buckets refresh at Bangkok midnight.
Opaque revision leaks no unrelated private activity; revoked content clears and authorized draft is preserved.

variants.title: Runtime/migration/backup roles and Windows recovery
variants.setup: Clean Windows target; SQL Server2022 edition/build recorded; separate runtime/migration/backup accounts and synthetic fixture.
steps: Install exact candidate ZIP; check service restart/HTTPS/ACL/scheduler and least privilege.
Back up then RESTORE into clean instance with paired uploads; upgrade/rollback supported schema and local Admin recovery.
expected: Runtime cannot migrate/read backup secrets; service and SQL paths/ACL are verified.
Actual restore validates rows/bytes/checksums and revokes sessions; VERIFYONLY alone is insufficient; no default account.

variants.title: Multipart and idempotency scope
variants.setup: Same user/key and distinct users/routes; multipart identical content with differing boundaries, changed bytes or metadata.
steps: Replay identical request; reuse key with altered canonical JSON or actual file content; expire key by controlled clock.
Replay after access revocation; verify retention exception routes and bodyless/DELETE-version wire shape.
expected: Canonical content matches once across equivalent encodings; mismatched intent conflicts; user/method/path scope isolated.
Replay rechecks visibility; no duplicate comments/files/bytes or leaked response.

variants.title: Audit and notification atomic primitives
variants.setup: Foundation-level real DB harness, eligible recipients and synthetic actor; event/notification insert failure switches.
steps: Mutate feature state while audit/notification persistence fails; retry same key; race with recipient revocation.
expected: Required feature state, audit and notifications commit together or all roll back.
No placeholder hooks; recipients/dedupe obey scope and no-self rule.

Assignment, notification, board/checklist/file, done and report
Cross-team Editor/Viewer and revoke all channels
Concurrent edit/move and explicit conflict recovery
Clean restore, permissions/files/checksums and new login

sequencing.rule: Provide minimal real provider-specific fixtures/transaction harness plus atomic audit/notification persistence before feature closure. T-067 expands harness later; it is not the first test execution.
Full deactivate/demote acceptance cannot close until effective-rights cleanup is implemented and tested; partial implementation stays IN_PROGRESS.
Full recurring completion cannot close until atomic successor/dedupe behavior is tested; non-recurring subset alone is partial.
Finalize history/dispatch features on top of foundation persistence; earlier feature transactions must already store required events/notifications.
Produce labeled candidate ZIP in pre-release/T-065 for Windows/UAT; T-074/T-076/T-077 remain incomplete until real required evidence and dependencies pass.
